title: LDL cholesterol

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: LDL stands for low-density lipoprotein, often called the bad cholesterol. It is the main source of blockages in the arteries.
context: LDL is measured as part of a cholesterol test that may need fasting for 9 to 12 hours beforehand. The LDL value may be calculated as an estimate from total cholesterol, HDL, and triglycerides, or measured directly; in general a low LDL level is good for heart health.
aboveRange: Eating foods high in saturated fat and cholesterol
Excess weight and a lack of physical activity
Family history and genes, which cannot be changed
A higher LDL can be associated with buildup of plaque in the arteries and a greater risk of heart problems
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
